name: Quest Self
description: The whole assistant a Quest user meets: one assistant, judged as the person meets it across a day of ordinary requests in their own quests.
purpose: Make each Quest user meet one whole assistant whose parts agree, so that a part passing its own test cannot hide a failure that the person finds out about.
approach: Run each request through the flow in the_self/respond.py, and score the assistant by one balanced number over day-with-assistant cases from Quest.
out_of_scope: How each part does its job: the hub's The Self owns the general flow and its metric.
milestones: 1. The one balanced number over day-with-assistant cases from Quest is committed before any arm is scored.
measures_of_success: One balanced number over turns of the written day-with-assistant cases, scored from the world afterwards and the reply, with the cases tagged by what each one asks of the assistant.
outputs: The assistant's answer and the changes it made.
effects: Those of the parts it calls.
usage_notes: The flow of one request is the_self/respond.py.
